excluded.reason: Members-only videos were excluded because they were not publicly downloadable.

artifactAudit.evidenceNote: Full local corpus artifacts were audited before distillation; source media are not bundled in the runtime skill.

videoTypes.name: compressed explainer
videoTypes.useWhen: One concept, term, library, feature, or workflow needs fast payoff-first definition.
videoTypes.shape: Claim, definition, mechanism, concrete example, tradeoff or callback.

videoTypes.name: trend/news commentary
videoTypes.useWhen: A release, incident, funding event, lawsuit, security story, or ecosystem shift needs context and implication.
videoTypes.shape: Claim, why it matters, timeline, technical mechanism, winner/loser analysis, final implication.

videoTypes.name: tutorial/overview
videoTypes.useWhen: A stack, API, framework, or workflow needs teachable layered steps.
videoTypes.shape: Promise outcome, prerequisites, smallest working object, layered concepts, warning, when to use.

videoTypes.name: deep walkthrough
videoTypes.useWhen: Screen/code time is the core value and the viewer needs implementation detail.
videoTypes.shape: Long screen/code segments with montage resets every 2-4 minutes.

visualSources.name: logo/title anchor
visualSources.useWhen: The viewer must identify the technology or story subject immediately.

visualSources.name: UI proof
visualSources.useWhen: A claim depends on visible product, docs, dashboard, browser, GitHub, or terminal evidence.
visualSources.placement: Cut directly from the spoken claim to the evidence, then punch into the exact region.

visualSources.name: code proof
visualSources.useWhen: The mechanism is best shown by one highlighted line, command, schema, or API call.

visualSources.name: diagram proof
visualSources.useWhen: The viewer needs to see lifecycle, dependency, state, timeline, or request flow.

visualSources.name: human/context insert
visualSources.useWhen: A founder, speaker, conference clip, article author, or legal actor establishes story credibility.

visualSources.name: meme/editorial insert
visualSources.useWhen: A joke, reversal, or absurd contrast punctuates a technical point.
visualSources.placement: After the claim is already understandable.

animationAtoms.name: punch-in zoom
animationAtoms.useWhen: Focus the viewer on the exact UI, code, logo, metric, or doc line that proves the point.

animationAtoms.name: fast pan
animationAtoms.useWhen: Traverse a screenshot, timeline, issue thread, or docs page without lingering on irrelevant regions.

animationAtoms.name: highlight sweep
animationAtoms.useWhen: Reveal one meaningful line, value, API, warning, or command.

animationAtoms.name: stack build
animationAtoms.useWhen: Layer logo, docs, code, output, and warning into a quick causal chain.

animationAtoms.name: split-screen contrast
animationAtoms.useWhen: Compare old/new, hype/reality, problem/fix, local/cloud, or before/after.

animationAtoms.name: counter/ticker
animationAtoms.useWhen: A number, cost, version, latency, time window, or count is the claim.

animationAtoms.name: diagram trace
animationAtoms.useWhen: Show request, network, dependency, lifecycle, or event flow moving through nodes.

transitionTypes.name: hard cut
transitionTypes.useWhen: A new claim, proof point, joke, or section starts.

transitionTypes.name: punch-in
transitionTypes.useWhen: The next idea is a smaller detail inside the same source visual.

transitionTypes.name: match cut
transitionTypes.useWhen: Two UI shapes, diagrams, logos, or code blocks map to each other.

transitionTypes.name: glitch/wipe
transitionTypes.useWhen: A section reset, failure state, security story, or surprising reversal needs punctuation.

transitionTypes.name: snap zoom
transitionTypes.useWhen: A joke, warning, or surprising number needs emphasis.

transitionTypes.name: title reset
transitionTypes.useWhen: A long walkthrough needs a recap card or new chapter marker.

audioRoles.name: background bed
audioRoles.useWhen: Maintain near-continuous pace under voiceover; duck under narration.

audioRoles.name: hit/stinger
audioRoles.useWhen: Title reveal, punchline, claim reversal, or section break.

audioRoles.name: whoosh/tick
audioRoles.useWhen: Zooms, pop-in labels, quick UI pans, code highlights, and overlay movement.

audioRoles.name: low impact
audioRoles.useWhen: Security incident, outage, lawsuit, cost spike, or serious warning.

audioRoles.name: riser
audioRoles.useWhen: Build tension before revealing a number, product, consequence, or warning.

audioRoles.name: dropout
audioRoles.useWhen: Create a sub-second joke pause or serious warning contrast.

audioRoles.name: final tail
audioRoles.useWhen: Let the callback or last warning resolve after the final visual.

scriptMoves.name: claim hook
scriptMoves.useWhen: Open with the consequence or contradiction before background.

scriptMoves.name: one-sentence context
scriptMoves.useWhen: Compress prerequisite context before showing evidence.

scriptMoves.name: contrast pair
scriptMoves.useWhen: Make the mechanism memorable by contrasting old/new, simple/hidden, or hype/reality.

scriptMoves.name: reset line
scriptMoves.useWhen: After dense explanation, reorient the viewer before the next proof.

scriptMoves.name: technical joke
scriptMoves.useWhen: A joke makes the mechanism easier to remember and does not replace the proof.

scriptMoves.name: warning beat
scriptMoves.useWhen: Name the limitation, footgun, cost, lock-in, latency, or security tradeoff.

scriptMoves.name: callback
scriptMoves.useWhen: End by returning to the opening claim with a sharper technical implication.

audioProfile.productionImplication: Use voiceover-led pacing with a continuous background bed, ducking under narration, short hits, whooshes, ticks, risers, rare dropouts, and a final tail.
